```{r setup, include = FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
```

# Problem 1

## Read and clean the subway dataset

```{r import}
subway_df = 
  read_csv(
    file = "data/NYC_Transit_Subway_Entrance_And_Exit_Data.csv",
    na = c("", "NA", ".")
  )
```

```{r clean}
subway_df = janitor::clean_names(subway_df)
```

```{r select}
select(subway_df, line, station_name, station_latitude, station_longitude,
       route1, route2, route3, route4, route5, route6, route7, route8, route9,
       route10, route11, entry, vending, entrance_type, ada)
```
